definitions.meaning: A number of days, a course of days

quotations.old_english: Wiste ðe geornor ðæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dógora dægrím
quotations.english: he knew the better that his life's end was passed, his days' number

quotations.old_english: Upon ðæt ígland ðǽr Apollines dóhtor wunode dægrímes worn
quotations.english: upon the island where Apollo's daughter dwelt a number of days

source_text: dæg-rím, es; n. [dæg day, rím a number] A number of days, a course of days; dierum numerus :-- Wiste ðe geornor ðæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dógora dægrím he knew the better that his life's end was passed, his days' number, Beo. Th. 1650; B. 823. Upon ðæt ígland ðǽr Apollines dóhtor wunode dægrímes worn upon the island where Apollo's daughter dwelt a number of days, Bt. Met. Fox 26, 66; Met. 26, 33: Cd. 47; Th. 60, 1; Gen. 975: 67; Th. 80, 20; Gen. 1331, On his dægríme in his number of days, Exon. 83 b; Th. 314, 10; Mód. 12. Dægríme fród wise in number of days, 130 a; Th. 498, 15; Rä. 88, 2: Cd. 99; Th. 131, 9; Gen. 2173.
